（，融合剑道，破开了聂科的绝灵之剑，差点将聂科重伤。
聂科胸口处有涅槃真意在源源不断的修复伤口，只是，那伤口中残存着极道道韵，太白以杀伐著称，其破坏力何等惊人，也可以时间也无法快速修复伤势。
“我还有两剑，便化作一剑向你问剑吧！”
聂科平静的说道，太白子神情虽然依旧平静，但眼眸显然比之前多了更多的凝重。
聂科的战力出乎他的预料，上一次交手太白子还从容有余，甚至可以说是热身，但这一次他不得不承认，如果他不动用全力，很可能真的被聂科击败。
聂科已经真正有了与他交手的资格。
“可惜了，如果是上一世的我，恐怕真的有可能被你击败！”
（第22页）太白子在心中喃喃自语，这是他的第四世了，他已经重修过四次了，无论是对太白经的感悟，还是对剑道的修炼，都已经到了一个返璞归真的境界了。
也正是因为如此，太白子才知晓他眼前的这个剑道青年的天赋有多么的恐怖。
太白子在心中喃喃自语，他剑道修炼了四世，才到达如此境界，而眼前这个青年才修炼多少年？从他生命光韵来看，还不到百岁吧，但剑道就已经快追赶上他了。
而宴席上，不败主冷寂微微说道：“还敢分心，看来是有绝对自信！”
他话音落下，只见战场中的聂科轻声吐出四个字。
只见聂科拿起手中的宝剑，并没有向着太白子刺出，而是径直的，没有任何犹豫的直接插入了自己的眉心。
正在外界观目前观看这一战的聂宁一瞬间眼睛红了。
聂科用自己的剑插入自己的眉心中，剑尖从他的脑后插出，鲜血染红了他的剑身，此刻那柄宝剑显得格外的妖异冰冷。
聂科体内的生机在这一刻尽数化为死气，向着他插入自己眉心中的宝剑涌去。
聂科这种自残并没有让聂科丧命，相反，他的眼神更加明亮了。

此刻聂科内视自己的肉身在自己体内，有一道璀璨剑气。
这道剑气孕育着浓郁的仙光，仿佛是不属于人间之剑。
直到渡过第三劫全面蜕变后，他的神魂才能触摸这道剑气，也正是因为有这道剑气在，他可以时刻感悟这道剑气奥义，他剑道才会提升如此之快。
“上一次无法调动这道剑气，这一次，就让你尝一尝吧，也让我看看这道剑气究竟有多厉害！”
聂科喃喃自语，下一刻，他的神魂化作他自身，然后一把向着这道剑气抓去。
先天剑气颤动，璀璨无穷的剑道奥义融入聂科体内……现实中聂科猛然睁开眼眸，然后狠狠的将那吸收了自己鲜血插在自己眉心中的宝剑抽出。
那剑光中带着浓郁的死气与劫气，还有一道先天气体，这道剑气只不过是聂科体内溢散出来的一丝，但此刻，却像是天地间最纯正的剑光，大殿中所有剑客手中的宝剑都猛然颤动。
就连冷寂一直蕴养的神剑在这一刻也在晃动，这种晃动与之前面对太白子剑意想要一战不同，这种晃动更像是一种害怕……冷寂一把抓住可依旧无法让神剑平静。
冷寂起身，无法保持平静，而其他不败主原本漫不经心此刻也眼神无比凝重，他们感受到了威胁。
两剑合一，绝天绝地之剑，不，应该说是三剑合一。
以他体内的先天剑光为核心统御绝天绝地，助他逆伐杀敌！
感受到这一剑孕育的气息，太白子猛然惊呼，原本恍惚出神，此刻彻底回归战场，他眼神中带着不可思议，再也没有了之前的平静。
转眼间，聂科如同一只死亡凶兽，一剑刺向太白子的眉心。

Chapter 1532: Endless Heaven and Earth (Page 1)
(, fused with swordsmanship, broke through Nie Ke's sword of the soul, and almost seriously injured Nie Ke.
There was Nirvana's true meaning on Nie Ke's chest that was constantly repairing the wound. However, the wound still contained the Taoist rhyme of the extreme. Taibai was famous for his killing power. Its destructive power was so amazing that even time could not repair the injury quickly.
"I still have two swords, so I'll turn them into one and ask you for swordsmanship!"
Nie Ke said calmly. Although Taibaizi's expression was still calm, his eyes were obviously more solemn than before.
Nie Ke's fighting power was beyond his expectation. The last time he fought against Taibaizi, he was calm enough and could even be said to be a warm-up. However, this time he had to admit that if he didn't use all his strength, he might really be defeated by Nie Ke.
Nie Ke is truly qualified to fight with him.
"What a pity. If it were me in the previous life, I might really be defeated by you!"
(Page 22) Taibaizi murmured to himself that this was his fourth life, and he had re-cultivated it four times. Whether it was his understanding of the Taibai Sutra or his practice of swordsmanship, he had reached a state of returning to his original nature.
It was precisely because of this that Taibaizi realized how terrifying the talent of the swordsman young man in front of him was.
Taibaizi murmured to himself, he had practiced swordsmanship for four lifetimes before reaching such a state, and how many years had this young man in front of him only practiced? Judging from the aura of his life, he is still less than a hundred years old, but his swordsmanship is almost catching up with him.
At the banquet, the undefeated master Leng Ji said slightly: "You still dare to be distracted. It seems that you are absolutely confident!"
When he finished speaking, Nie Ke on the battlefield softly uttered four words.
I saw Nie Ke picking up the sword in his hand, and instead of stabbing Taibaizi, he directly inserted it between his eyebrows without any hesitation.
Nie Ning, who was watching the battle from the outside, turned red for a moment.
Nie Ke inserted his sword between his eyebrows, and the tip of the sword came out from the back of his head. The blood stained his sword body. At this moment, the sword looked particularly strange and cold.
All the vitality in Nie Ke's body turned into death energy at this moment, rushing towards the sword inserted between his eyebrows.
Nie Ke's self-mutilation did not kill Nie Ke. On the contrary, his eyes became brighter.
At this moment, Nie Ke looked inside his body, and there was a bright sword energy inside his body.
This sword energy is pregnant with rich fairy light, as if it is a sword that does not belong to the world.
It was not until he passed through the third calamity that he fully transformed, and his soul could touch this sword energy. It was precisely because of this sword energy that he could always comprehend the secret of this sword energy, and that was why his swordsmanship improved so quickly.
"I couldn't mobilize this sword energy last time. This time, I'll let you have a taste, and let me see how powerful this sword energy is!"
Nie Ke murmured to himself, and the next moment, his soul turned into himself, and then grabbed the sword energy.
The innate sword energy trembled, and the infinite and brilliant secrets of the sword merged into Nie Ke's body... In reality, Nie Ke suddenly opened his eyes, and then fiercely pulled out the sword that had absorbed his own blood and was inserted between his eyebrows.
The sword light contained a strong aura of death and calamity, as well as an innate gas. This sword aura was just a trace of the sword energy emanating from Nie Ke's body, but at this moment, it was like the purest sword light in the world. The swords in the hands of all the swordsmen in the hall trembled suddenly.
Even the divine sword that Leng Ji had been cultivating was shaking at this moment. This kind of shaking was different from the previous fight against Taibaizi's sword intention. This kind of shaking was more like a kind of fear... Leng Ji grabbed it but still couldn't calm the divine sword.Leng Ji stood up, unable to remain calm, while the other undefeated masters, who were originally careless, now had extremely serious eyes, feeling threatened.
The two swords merge into one, the sword that can conquer heaven and earth. No, it should be said that it is three swords merged into one.
With the innate sword light in his body as the core, he can control the heavens and the earth and help him fight against the enemy!
Feeling the breath of this sword, Taibaizi suddenly exclaimed. He was originally in a trance, but now he completely returned to the battlefield. There was disbelief in his eyes, and he no longer had the calmness before.
In the blink of an eye, Nie Ke was like a death beast, stabbing Taibaizi between the eyebrows with a sword.
